answer_1.quote: We evaluate our model, SMBOP (SeMiautoregressive Bottom-up semantic Parser), on SPIDER, a challenging zero-shot text-to-SQL dataset.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate performance with the official SPIDER evaluation script, which computes exact match (EM), i.e., whether the predicted SQL query is identical to the gold query after some query normalization. ... the evaluation script computes denotation accuracy, that is, whether executing the output SQL query results in the right denotation (answer).
